analyst_pushback: Middle East impact quantification: Analyst pressed on revenue loss and cost provision risk. Management responded impact limited to select sectors; customer discussions underway for cost recovery; major Hydrocarbon projects in engineering phase, unaffected.

Margin reconciliation: Analyst questioned ECL provisions vs robust collections claim. Management clarified ECL based on receivable aging, specific to Water/Effluent Treatment and legacy Indian project completions; Q1 effect only.

Domestic pipeline risk: Analyst challenged whether government budget constraints could defer domestic prospects. Management countered 'delivered very good order inflow; guidance remains consistent.' Highlighted private sector orders strength.

Fixed price exposure: Analyst asked percentage of fixed price orders amid cost inflation. Management confirmed 50% of order book fixed price; 70-80% Hydrocarbon projects in procurement phase, insulated from supply chain impact.
tone_evidence: Management affirms order guidance despite geopolitical headwinds; emphasizes 'resilience' and 'positioned well'; but cautious on revenue outlook, stating 'prudent to wait for greater clarity.'
